subtitle.zh: 一闪 · 留住每一个念头
subtitle.en: A place for your passing thoughts

category.zh: 本地优先 · 原生应用

description.zh: 灵感、日志、情绪和任务，在一个安静的空间里。Android、macOS 与 HarmonyOS 原生三端，让记录留在你的设备上。
description.en: Ideas, journals, moods and tasks in one quiet space. Three native apps for Android, macOS and HarmonyOS, with your records kept on your device.

imageAlt.zh: Flash Android 此刻页：今天的片段、快速记录和底部导航
imageAlt.en: Flash Android Today screen with daily summary, quick capture and navigation

body.zh: 快速文本记录，日志与灵感按时间排列。用关键词、标签和日期寻找内容，macOS 菜单栏也能快速记下一笔。
body.en: Quick text capture with a chronological record of journals and ideas. Find entries by keyword, tag and date, or capture from the macOS menu bar.

body.zh: 日历里的任务、截止日期与提醒，搭配七级情绪和笔记。回顾本周、本月、近 30 天或近 90 天的变化。
body.en: Calendar tasks, deadlines and reminders alongside seven mood levels and notes. Review your week, month, last 30 or last 90 days.

body.zh: 统一 v2 备份包含任务，支持导入差异预览、合并与替换，以及旧版恢复。跨端真机互传验收仍在推进。
body.en: Shared v2 backups include tasks, import previews, merge or replace options and legacy recovery. Cross-platform device transfer validation is still in progress.

subtitle.zh: 云端共和国 · 在金星，建一座城
subtitle.en: Build a city in the clouds of Venus

category.zh: 卡牌策略 · 浏览器游戏

description.zh: 在硫酸云层之上，用卡牌、资源与每一回合的选择守住浮城。66 张卡牌、20 个事件，让每一次建设都有新的可能。
description.en: Above the sulfuric clouds, keep a floating city alive through cards, resources and choices. 66 cards and 20 events make every run a new possibility.

imageAlt.zh: Cloud Republic 开始界面：新建共和国、难度选择与卡牌规则
imageAlt.en: Cloud Republic start screen with difficulty selection and card rules

title.en: A city shaped by your deck.

body.zh: 66 张卡牌与 20 个环境事件，搭配阵营、牌库构筑、局外传承和 9 节点科技树。
body.en: 66 cards and 20 environmental events, with factions, deck building, meta progression and a nine-node tech tree.

body.zh: 每回合最多打出 3 张牌，平衡资源、修理与建设。在最终回合前达到 100% 净化、建成至少 6 个栖息地。
body.en: Play up to three cards each turn and balance resources, repairs and construction. Reach 100% purification and at least six habitats before the final turn.

body.zh: 三档难度与沙盒，中英双语与三套主题。支持离线运行、本地存档和确定性重放；主分支已完成 TypeScript 迁移。
body.en: Three difficulties and a sandbox, Chinese/English and three themes. Offline play, local saves and deterministic replay, with the TypeScript migration completed.

subtitle.zh: 汽车运动社 · We race as one.
subtitle.en: Motorsport club · We race as one.

category.zh: 社团实践 · 赛车文化

description.zh: 东华 DHGT 汽车运动社（东城），延续生态园的汽车运动文化。一起认识赛事与工程，体验模拟赛车，分享汽车文化与影像创作。
description.en: DHGT Motorsport Club in Dongcheng carries forward Ecology Park’s racing culture. Discover racing and engineering, explore sim racing, and share car culture and visual stories.

status.zh: 关注公众号获取活动消息
status.en: Follow the club for activity news
